description: Result `old_range`/`new_range` values are `[start_row, start_col, end_row, end_col]`: rows are 1-based, columns are 0-based UTF-8 BYTE offsets (tree-sitter convention, not character indexes), and the end is exclusive.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the file to edit.

name.description: Name of the symbol to replace.

new_body.description: Replacement text for the symbol. Spans the symbol's full line range, including the same leading indentation get_symbol returns in its body. Do not append a trailing newline.

repo.description: Repo containing the file. Optional when the catalog has a single repo.

kind.description: Optional symbol kind (e.g. function, class) to disambiguate when several symbols share the name.

qualified.description: Optional dotted container path exactly as get_symbol reports in `qualified` (e.g. `Outer.method`). Use it when several same-kind symbols share the name in different containers — `kind` cannot tell those apart.

row.description: Optional 1-based start row of the intended symbol (its `range[0]`). Use it when duplicates share both kind and container, e.g. two C++ overloads of the same function. (A C prototype and its definition differ in `kind`: `prototype` vs `function`.)
